messages.subject: does geom_text jitter when using hjust?
parts:
This problem pertains to my previous post to this list (How to use
"expand_range"), but since it's another question I hope it is the
correct approach to ask two seperate questions.

When I call ggplot with
ggplot(dm, aes(x=variable,y=value,group=Type,label=Type,size=I.alt))+
geom_line(aes(col=value2))+
geom_text(data=subset(dm, variable=="idx08"),hjust=-0.2,
size=3,position=position_jitter(w=0, h=0))+
theme_bw()+
scale_x_discrete("", labels=c("2006", "2007", "2008"), expand=c(0,1))+
scale_y_continuous("", formatter="percent")+
opts(legend.position="none")+
scale_colour_manual(values=c("green","red"))

I notice that geom_text is not alligned properbly. I am assuming is
some kind of jittering - but I can't turn it off. I can increase the
jittering (cf the call to geom_text) - but not turn it off. Whats
going on?

This does not happen with hjust=0.

messages.subject: Re: does geom_text jitter when using hjust?
parts:
The hjust parameter is proportional to the width of the text. You
probably want something like:

ggplot(dm, aes(variable, value,group=Type,label=Type,size=I.alt))+
geom_line(aes(col=value2))+
geom_text(aes(as.numeric(variable) + 0.1), data=subset(dm,
variable=="idx08"),hjust= 0,
size=3)

Hadley
